content: Metrics. Three metrics in text simplification are chosen in this paper. BLEU BIBREF5 is one traditional machine translation metric to assess the degree to which translated simplifications differed from reference simplifications. FKGL measures the readability of the output BIBREF23 . A small FKGL represents simpler output. SARI is a recent text-simplification metric by comparing the output against the source and reference simplifications BIBREF20 .
